$comment: The mark registry. A mark that is not listed here is not shipped — the tests
assert the directory and this file agree in both directions, so an orphan SVG
or a dangling entry fails the build rather than quietly half-existing.
`tier` is the brand relationship, and it is the thing that decides how much a
product  a thing we ship and name (Lattice, Warden). Own figure, shared palette.
family   a member of a named set (the *-axi tools). Shares a figure motif with
its siblings and differs by one element.

marks.name: PixelOven
marks.figure: a nine-pixel grid inside a rounded chamber, centre pixel lit

marks.name: Lattice
marks.figure: crossed diagonal bands clipped to a diamond — latticework
